_comment: Live posts (2.4.8, inc/liveblog): `liveblog` loads only on a live post's page; the small live badge (+ 2.4.14 header pill) rides in `core` because story cards and the nav show it everywhere. 2.4.14: the homepage "এখন লাইভ" band — its CSS is part of the homepage critical CSS (above the fold), `liveband` = its 60 s refresh script, enqueued only while a live post runs.
